# test/fixtures/memorial

Two small photographs used by `test/memorial-faces.test.js` and `test/memorial-gallery.test.js`.

Both depict a FICTIONAL person. They were generated with Higgsfield `gpt_image_2_6` on 2026-11-24
(jobs 7ea76849 and d871f982, owner's account) with no real person's likeness as a reference, then
reduced to fixture size. No customer photograph is, or may ever be, committed to this repository.
